decisions.intent: Deliver a complete level-authoring workflow: shape terrain, place and configure all required mission objects, save and reload a level, then play that authored level through the ordinary game entry point.
material_capabilities: placement and configuration of all required mission objects
ordinary-entry play of the authored result
explicit_descoping: A preview and one launch-speed control do not provide terrain or mission-object authoring, persistence, reload, or ordinary-entry play.
decisions.proof_journey: Author a level with terrain and required mission objects, save it, reload it in a fresh session, enter through the normal game flow, and play the saved authored result.
invalid_substitutes: passing ACs and tests that cover only those controls
decisions.rationale: The candidate loses the central authoring and persistence capabilities; its passing checklist only proves the narrowed preview/control subset.

decisions.intent: Make account recovery usable through the normal browser route at phone and desktop sizes, including error recovery and keyboard navigation.
explicit_descoping: No additional account-recovery features are needed beyond the requested responsive, error-recovery, and keyboard journey.
decisions.proof_journey: In a rendered browser, open the normal recovery route at phone and desktop viewports, submit invalid input, recover from the error, and complete keyboard-only navigation through the relevant controls.
decisions.rationale: The requested outcome is rendered-browser usability. The candidate provides only code-level proxies and has not exercised the required journey.

decisions.intent: Verify that the currently deployed worker runs the exact reviewed source revision and correctly processes the live contract.
material_capabilities: observation of the deployed worker's source revision
identity match to the reviewed revision
live-contract processing by that deployed worker
explicit_descoping: Local-worker verification and deployment-command success do not establish deployed source identity.
decisions.proof_journey: Observe the deployed worker's immutable revision identity, compare it with the reviewed revision, then send or observe a safe live-contract transaction and verify the deployed worker's result.
invalid_substitutes: A local worker passing a fixture
decisions.rationale: The candidate never observes the runtime artifact's identity, so it cannot verify that the live worker is the reviewed source even if local behavior and deployment submission succeed.

decisions.intent: Complete onboarding so an organisation administrator can invite a member, that member can join, and both participants see the correct resulting organisation state.
explicit_descoping: Child-row completion does not replace the invitation, join, and resulting-state journey.
decisions.proof_journey: From a new organisation administrator session, invite a member; complete the invitation and join as that member; then verify the resulting organisation state in both administrator and member sessions.
decisions.rationale: The candidate omits the cross-user invitation and joined-state outcome that defines the Epic, despite its internal checklist being complete.

decisions.intent: Correct only the misspelled Export label in the accepted settings screen, preserving export behaviour and the existing layout.
decisions.proof_journey: Verify the focused UI assertion for the corrected label and inspect the bounded diff to confirm that export behavior and layout are unchanged.
decisions.rationale: The proposal is precisely bounded to the requested correction, includes focused proof, and does not broaden the already accepted screen.

decisions.intent: Replace the legacy importer for every documented customer record shape while preserving validation errors and rollback.
material_capabilities: replacement support for every documented record shape
explicit_descoping: A simplest-shape canary is not delivery for the other documented shapes or replacement-path rollback.
decisions.proof_journey: Run each documented customer-record shape through the replacement importer, verify its specified validation-error behavior, induce a safe failure, and verify rollback without relying on the legacy importer.
invalid_substitutes: leaving other shapes or rollback on the legacy path
decisions.rationale: The candidate implements only a subset and retains required behavior on the legacy path; it has not completed the requested replacement.
